Jordan: Morning — quick async pulse.
What I did: pushed a fix to the KV cache heuristic that should reduce cold-start latency for long contexts (llama3-xxlQ variant). Ran local smoke evals.
Blockers: regression in free-text QA evals vs. baseline on prompt set customer_sim_v2 (drop in exact match ~4%). I think it's related to the cache change but not 100% sure.
Today: revert locally then A/B patch; kicking off a 200-sample eval sweep; @Maria can you glance at the prompt set? @Alex can you spare a runner for the sweep?

Maria: saw the CI alert earlier. I'll diff the prompt set, especially the examples with multi-turn context. Quick note: one example has an extra punctuation token — might explain mismatch. I'll send a small patch if confirmed.

Alex: I can spin up a 2nd eval worker in ~15m. Will attach logs when done. :thumbsup:

Jordan: attaching failing snippet:
```python
# failing assertion from eval harness
assert normalize(pred) == normalize(gold), f'mismatch at idx {i}: {pred} vs {gold}'
```
Mismatch sample idx 47 looks like whitespace trimming issue.

eval-bot: eval-job-3987 started by Alex (samples=200, model=llama3-xxlq, seed=721).

Maria: quick diff applied to prompt set — removed stray unicode NBSP and normalized quotes. Pushed to branch `prompt-fix/196873`.

Jordan: thanks. I'm going to run the sweep with patched prompts + cache revert, will post results. If that reduces regression, we can cherry-pick minimal prompt normalizations into prod.

deploy-bot: canary deployment for runtime patch rolled to 2/3 nodes. Monitor latency dashboards for 10m.

Alex: eval-job-3987 finished — initial metrics: EM delta -0.3% with patched prompts, runtime p50 unchanged. Uploading full report: https://internal/reports/3987

Jordan: great, looks like prompt normalization accounted for most of the drop. I'll open a small PR to the runtime with cache heuristics toggle (opt-in) so we can roll without surprises. Thanks all. :rocket:
